name: taskboard-idle-inbox
description: Delivers Taskboard inbox items for the runs this session started or claimed: within seconds while idle or busy on servers whose inbox can wait, otherwise by checking while idle. A /taskboard side pane shows those runs, their inbox and the queue.

minIntervalSeconds.title: First check after idle (seconds)
minIntervalSeconds.description: On servers that cannot wait: wait after a turn ends before the first inbox check; also the interval right after new items arrive. Also the first retry after a failed read.

maxIntervalSeconds.title: Longest interval (seconds)
maxIntervalSeconds.description: On servers that cannot wait, the interval doubles while nothing changes, up to this. Also the longest retry interval after failed reads.

boardUrl.title: Taskboard web URL
boardUrl.description: Base URL of the Taskboard web UI, such as https://taskboard.example.com. The pane links tasks to it; empty shows plain task IDs.
